status: Fixed before inspecting model performance; local research benchmark, not registered prospective study
task: Predict reported percent mean grain size (MGS); lower means stronger IRI in the specified assay, not higher cell survival

cohorts.amino: Only 63 train/test records at nominal 20 mM in 10 mM NaCl; preserve 17 source-selected predict records as a separate diagnostic, with concentration conflicts excluded from condition-matched evaluation
cohorts.glyco2: Only records explicitly labelled 22 mM in PBS; do not concatenate the overlapping Glyco subset

features: 16 recomputed two-dimensional RDKit descriptors; no labels, error bars, names, set flags or source predictions as inputs. Archived upstream descriptors not required for this baseline.

models.median: DummyRegressor(strategy=median), fitted on training fold only
models.ridge: StandardScaler then Ridge(alpha=10); scaler fitted on training fold only
models.forest: RandomForestRegressor(n_estimators=300, min_samples_leaf=3, random_state=42, n_jobs=1), all other defaults

primary_validation: Five-fold GroupKFold without shuffle using nonchiral Bemis-Murcko scaffolds; all acyclic molecules share one group
secondary_validation: Five-fold shuffled GroupKFold(random_state=42) by canonical nonstereochemical connectivity, keeping stereoisomers together
metrics: Out-of-fold MAE, RMSE, R2 and equal-weight scaffold MAE; all models/splits reported, no hyperparameter search or model selection on held-out outcomes
uncertainty: 2000 bootstrap resamples of group-mean paired absolute-error differences (model minus median), seed 42; descriptive percentile intervals conditional on this dataset and split, not independent confirmation or per-molecule intervals
candidate_handling: 2FA is present in Glyco2: report its withheld-scaffold prediction and observed assay value explicitly. No trained-on-self novelty claim. Mixtures, polymers and proteins are not represented as single small molecules.
limitations: A new simple baseline on the published task, not an exact reproduction of the paper's multi-representation ensemble
Grouped cross-validation assesses withheld structures in existing data, not prospective experimental validation
Scaffold groups are imbalanced and coarse; empty scaffolds share a group
The 2D features do not resolve all stereochemical effects
Glyco2 pools literature sources; concentration filtering does not establish complete inter-lab protocol equivalence
No cell viability, pathway inhibition, cocktail interaction, dose-response or iPSC efficacy prediction
